summary: The interview focuses on an incident involving a witness, who witnessed a man with a knife demanding money from a woman at a cash machine last Saturday evening. Key evidence includes the witness's detailed observations of the suspect's arrival and actions during the event. The principal suspect is the man with the knife, whose motives appear to be robbery. The interview concludes with a summary of the witness's statements, which will aid in the ongoing investigation.

parts.title: Interview Introduction
parts.description: The interview begins at Riverside Police Station with Daniel Hargraves, a resident of Millend, providing context for the investigation.

chapters.title: Interview Introduction
chapters.gist: The interview is conducted at Riverside Police Station with Daniel Hargraves, who lives in Millend.

parts.title: The Night in Question
parts.description: Daniel recounts the events of the previous Saturday evening, detailing the appearance of a man with a knife and his observations regarding the timing and circumstances of the incident.

chapters.title: The Night in Question

parts.title: Witness Description of Incident
parts.description: A witness corroborates Daniel's account, describing the man with the knife and the demand made towards a woman at the cash machine, providing critical evidence for the case.

chapters.title: Witness Description of Incident

parts.title: Interview Conclusion
